opportunities.name: Movie night invite from IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes
opportunities.description: For a given movie, look up director/runtime/IMDb rating on IMDb and Tomatometer on Rotten Tomatoes, then compose an email to a friend with the details.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page
Note director, runtime and IMDb rating
Search the title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page
Open mail compose, enter recipient and subject 'Movie night <day>: <title>'
Type body with director, runtime, IMDb and Tomatometer values

instances.values: The Grand Budapest Hotel, aisha@example.com, Sunday

opportunities.name: npm package stats note
opportunities.description: For an npm package, find version, weekly downloads and license on npmjs, then stars, open issues and last release on GitHub, and save a summary note.
steps: Search the package name on npmjs
Open Releases and note latest release date, stars, open issues
Add a note in Notes with the summary

opportunities.name: Recipe summary note with origin
opportunities.description: For a dish, find the Allrecipes recipe (rating, time, ingredients), look up its origin on Wikipedia, and save a note with servings.
steps: Search the dish on Allrecipes and open the top recipe
Note rating, total time, first ingredients
Search the dish on Wikipedia and note its origin
Add a note: '<dish> for <n>: recipe (rating, time), needs ingredients. Origin: X'
